messages:
sara_sales: ACME POC hitting 413 Request Entity Too Large when we send full docs array to /v1/chat/completions. Happens once history grows past ~180k chars. Anyone seen this? /cc @james_se

james_se: Which model and exact endpoint? streaming or non-streaming? Can you paste request headers (Content-Length) + any error body?

sara_sales: Model: redwood-1-instruct, endpoint: POST /v1/chat/completions, not streaming. Latest failure: Content-Length: 123456
Server response:
```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "message": "request entity too large",
    "code": 413
  }
}
```

tao_engineering: FYI we have a proxy limit on hosted API at ~100KB (configurable for Dedicated/Private). 413 is payload-size at the HTTP layer, not the model token window. Also log shows token_count=5120 (so token limit not hit). We should guide them to reduce request bytes or use upload-reference flow.

marta_support: Workarounds to give ACME quickly:
1) Summarize / truncate older messages client-side before sending. Keep request body under ~80-90KB to be safe.
2) Use our blob upload + reference_id pattern (upload large docs to S3, then include a short reference in the chat payload).
3) Retrieval-augmented approach: store docs as embeddings and send only top-K contexts per request.
4) If they need large single payloads, recommend Dedicated or Private (we can raise proxy limits).

james_se: Is there a small example of the upload+reference pattern? customer wants a copy-paste snippet they can try now.

tao_engineering: Noting we don't have stitched streaming sessions on hosted yet. Experimental multipart API exists for enterprise on request. For now use this pattern:

1) Upload file: POST /v1/blobs (multipart/form-data) -> returns blob_id
2) Send chat request referencing blob:
```json
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "redwood-1-instruct",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"reference:blob:1234"},
    {"role":"user","content":"Please answer using the document in reference:blob:1234"}
  ]
}
```
This keeps payload small since the large doc is stored separately.

sara_sales: ACME needs a fix this week — can eng triage and confirm whether we can temporarily bump hosted limit for them?

tao_engineering: I've opened INC-2026-312 for triage, assigned to eng-runtime. ETA: 48h for evaluation. We can offer Dedicated trial or scoped increase for enterprise accounts, but need security sign-off for S3 blob usage.

marta_support: I'll draft a runbook and a JS summarization helper they can drop in: small script to collapse long message history into a 1-2 paragraph summary before sending. Also include recommended soft limit: 80KB body.

james_se: sending the summarization snippet to ACME now and asking them to try the blob flow. Will update after they test.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-312 created by tao_engineering and assigned to eng-runtime (priority: high).
